what_this_is: The rule this tool ships, read from the deploy for every account and never copied into anyone's store (the same file shape and reader as tools/starting-set/starting-rules.json). A method answer is kept with review `asked` only where its strictness says review (method-rows/answers.mjs); this rule hands that answer, with the words the answer carries (review_job, review_said), to one of the person's AIs. An answer with no review asked starts nothing, so a method is checked by its cheap check alone unless its row or its method asks for more.

every_account.label: Have one of your AIs look at a method answer whose strictness asks for a review
